body.statement: For every \(D\in\mathfrak D_T\), \(\widehat\tau-\tau=u_T(X)^{\top}g+v_T(X)^{\top}e\), \(\mathbb E_D[u_Tv_T^{\top}]=0\), \(\mathbb E_D[v_Tv_T^{\top}]=F_{T,q}F_{T,q}^{\top}\), and \(\mathcal R_T(D)=\max\{T R_g^2\lambda_{\max}(\mathbb E_D[u_Tu_T^{\top}]),\ T^2R_e^2\|F_{T,q}\|_{\mathrm{op}}^2\}\).
body.justification: This equality exposes fourth assignment moments as the only optimizable signal block while preserving the design-invariant disturbance floor.
body.gap: Liang and Recht calculate the corresponding blocks under independent Rademacher assignment; they do not optimize the fourth-moment block over correlated pairwise-orthogonal laws.
body.consumer: It converts the causal design problem into a finite orbit SDP and supplies the lower noise-floor certificate for both main theorems.
